scripts.sync:android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:android && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug && node scripts/export-apk.mjs
scripts.build:android:release: npm run sync:android && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleRelease --no-daemon && node scripts/export-release-apk.mjs
